name: Ticketry.AI
tagline: Email a feature request and get a complete, structured ticket for developers, with follow-up questions.
problem: Requests from business users arrive incomplete and slow to triage.
solution: An inbound email agent turns messy requests into structured tickets, asks for missing details, and gives developers a board to claim and finish them.
demo_moment: Team-described: send a vague request and receive a clarifying reply.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of AgentMail API” among 122 submissions.
Business users need no new tool, only email.

lessons: Email as the interface removes onboarding entirely.
